body:
Map: 
Aquatic Urbex


Built By:
ProfessorUtonium
ALM
Or8

Images: http://imgur.com/a/fklUP
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/bgkytrnt1dy5cit/Seth8.rar
XML: https://pastebin.com/3r4MqaNZ
Banner/Map PNG: http://imgur.com/a/mMUhr


MAP TRAILER: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CU_xTassEjQ&feature=youtu.be
note: the trailer does not use the final version of the map. This was the first version. Please refer to the images for the latest version
Recorded by Or8
Acted/Edited by ALM
Special Effects/Behind the scenes work by ProfessorUtonium

Map Description:
The Map is an abandoned underwater research facility that's destroyed and ruined with erosion and nearby settlements. The map has 4 monuments on each team (2 obsidian on each monument) and the map does not limit what you do. You have the option to stay inside the research facility to reach the enemy team's monument or go outside into the water (using the highly advanced wetsuit that gives you depth strider3/aqua affinity) to travel faster. The map comes with sponges in the loadout to keep water away when trying to defend or go around the map. There are many areas to travel to such as abandoned islands, Whales, underwater temples, and more! have fun with water pvp

and yes
you get water breathing
night vision may be given to increase sight underwater after the map is tested (if accepted)
this is just an interesting take in DTM that we wanted to try out (underwater map)

my other maps: (I try to make my maps unique and different from the 500 other maps in the repo)
The Mines: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/4f4a329d4 - Theme: Abandoned Mine
